title: An elementary symmetric value of reciprocal integers

source.citation: Chunlin Wang and Shaofang Hong, The elementary symmetric functions of reciprocal arithmetic progressions, arXiv:1311.1389

translation.notes: The source's exceptional value S_(1,1)(3,2)=1 is independently computed as a coefficient of the generating polynomial for elementary symmetric functions. The explanatory prose and program are original; no paper source is redistributed.
